protocol.purpose: User-authorized isolated predictor/objective ablation, nonlearned controls and conditional small learning follow-up; no unconditional full training
protocol.noise_formula: base + repetition*10000 + speed*100 + path_index*10 + scenario_index; all methods share each cell's stream
protocol.physical_contract: Unchanged revision6 path/scenario definitions, Fiala plant, RK4, actuator/sensor/estimator and local LQR. Initial ey0.15m,heading0.01rad;10mscontrol;ceil((220/speed+2)/.01) ticks; finite-state episode failure abs ey>2.5m or abs headingerror>.6rad. Fill unexecuted error tails with2.5m. Nonfinite command/plant state is a run-integrity failure: preserve partial evidence, abort completion/selection, do not fabricate finite realized RMSE or silently omit the case. Primary metric is equally weighted mean episode penalized RMSE.
protocol.reference: Call original execution_step/predict_cost verbatim. Original revision8/9 every-available-worker policy query cadence; not the slower50ms-query revision10/11 diagnostic. Pure LQR executes baseline directly.
protocol.preview_only: Keep nominal linear dynamics,200ms horizon,50ms candidate hold,original combined cost and all gate/actuator rules. Vary predicted curvature using linear interpolation/clamping of existing0/10/20m actor previews, distance=measured_speed*time. Anchor first curvature to the existing local curvature input; other two come from float32 actor preview channels. Update equilibrium/feedforward continuation and yaw-reference cost along preview. No hidden stiffness/friction, future true states, exact future map queries or future measurement noise enters the predictor.
protocol.lateral_only: Keep original constant-curvature nominal linear predictor and timing. Remove heading/yaw/steering effort from scalar objective, retaining .01*(ey/.5)^2 stage and .1*(ey/.5)^2 terminal costs. Keep1% relative improvement margin and1e-7floor. This is an objective ablation, not a safety filter guarantee.
protocol.unchanged: Residual±.08rad,fullcommand±.5rad,physicalrate.35rad/s,actuatorlag.05s; freshness reject age>=50ms,original .1/.25/.5 blend limits,freshness scaling,.05/tick weight ramp,3tick persistence,validity/envelope/sequence checks. Same20student features,weights,train-onlystandardization. One in-flight worker,actual observation timestamps,simulated0/20/100ms service. All variants use same observations.
protocol.nonlearned_controls: Predeclared constant residuals−.04 and+.04 under EACH identical gate. Neither sign nor magnitude is selected or tuned from this run. Report both; require learned advantage over both to attribute extra benefit to the frozen student.
protocol.learning_benefit: At least1% overall mean penalizedRMSE reduction versus BOTH same-gate fixed corrections, and no cellwise survival loss against either. Report separately from gate_progress. A gate change benefiting only constants does not justify PPO training.
protocol.five_percent_target: At least5% lower RMSE versus LQR in at least two predeclared stress regions, each with lower error in all three paired seed means, and all gate_progress preservation checks. Overall5% is a separate reported quantity. This target is not a requirement to report smaller honest gains.
protocol.selection: Eligible only if BOTH gate_progress and learning_benefit pass. If only one passes, select it. If both pass and their overall means differ by<=1% of the lower mean, preferpreview to retain the original combined objective; otherwise select lower mean. No arm/threshold/weight/horizon changes after outcomes.
protocol.conditional_teacher: Only after a selected gate: independent DEV noise920000000, first two pairs,full36conditions,selected-gate student,fixed±.04,and future-noise-independent five-action200ms teacher=288episodes. Teacher clones selected gate in every branch with original worker cadence; zero/antithetic3 forecasts independent of actual noise. Teacher retains privileged current state/parameters, never deployable. Require>=1% gain over selected-gate student overall and each pair, no regional survival loss and<=1% active-regional regression before spending on retraining.
protocol.conditional_pilots: Only after teacher headroom passes: two100k categorical PPO fine-tuning jobs initialized exactly from existingstudent701/802,with selected gate in actual execution and reward branches. Retain revision9 hyperparameters/reward/20features/normalizer semantics; checkpoints0and100k only. Trainingnoise930000000+pair*1000000+slot*10000+episode. No architecture/reward/gate search. DEV940000000 compares endpoints vs same-gate frozenstudent,bothconstants,LQR,current-gate student. Retain endpoint only if>=1% overall improvement versus same-gate student,each pairbetter,no survival loss,nominal and every active region<=1% worse,and>=1% better than both constants. Otherwise retain frozenstudent; this is not PPO success.
protocol.conditional_reserved: Only if a gate passes initial screen and independent teacher confirmation, freeze selected gate and retained policies before opening noise950000000. Two paired policies,same36known physicalconditions; LQR,currentgate student,selectedgate fixed±.04,selectedgate frozenstudent,retainedpolicy=432episodes. Report all,even regressions; no post-test selection or retuning. Fresh noise is not unseen-road validation. If initial screen/teacher fails, do not open reserved split.
protocol.stop: Complete this finite decision tree only. Failed initial screen=>stop retraining path and leave reserved data unused. Failed teacher confirmation=>stop training and reserved evaluation. At most2x100k additionalRL steps, no300kextensions/5x1M/fulltraining/nativepromotion. Any new hypothesis requires a separate predeclared revision.
protocol.limitations: Three student/noise pairs and two known geometries; descriptive screening,not statistical proof. Ideal map localization/currentactuator are inherited simulation assumptions. Changing gate changes student history distribution; frozen weights isolate gate changes. Preview-only does not estimate actual tireparameters or fix modelmismatch by assumption. No formal stability/safety,hard realtime,native or SOTAclaim. Literature positioning is distinct from reproduced published algorithm comparisons.
